headline: Led by the Captain Who Helped Build Her
primaryText:
You are not driven across an ocean. You sail across it.

Oguz Khan is a private 50-meter sailing yacht, and she crosses at the speed the wind gives you. Her captain, Ümit Yıldırım, helped build her. He knows her from the keel up, he has crossed the Atlantic before, and he decides the route, the timing and the speed. That leaves your group free to enjoy the crossing. (cut off)
whyItWorks: The opening line reframes an ocean crossing as an experience rather than transport, which makes a scroller stop and reread. The captain's personal link to the boat and his earlier crossing build trust for a very expensive purchase. The sunset video with the on-screen line about 15 years at sea adds credibility and aspiration, and the soft call to request details suits a high-ticket enquiry.
